publication.head: codex/5339-v0918-wp04-language-core
publication.title: [v0.91.8][WP-04] Implement clean-room six-primitives language core
publication.body:
Closes #5339

Adds an independent, side-effect-free Rust language crate for ADL's provider, tool, agent, task, workflow, and singular run primitives. It provides duplicate-key-safe strict YAML/JSON parsing, a checked generated JSON Schema, stable semantic diagnostics for identities/references/state/cycles/run targets, and deterministic canonical JSON that sorts maps while preserving declared sequence order.

The reviewed #5337 corpus is mapped explicitly: all applicable language and ordering cases pass, compiler pattern expansion remains #5338 scope, and mock execution remains #5340 scope. Typed local validation passes 3 characterization plus 7 language tests, strict Clippy, exact five-package COTS/dependency guards, 702 implementation and 648 test/fixture lines (well under 4000/4000), and sub-second warm validation. Exact-revision review found no actionable findings after all remediations. No AWS, raw gh, Runtime v2, provider, network, control-plane, cloud, database, or migration authority was added.
